name: Google Drive sync
author: Miika Havo
description: Google Drive sync status in the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Sync status, per-folder results, and a manual sync trigger.

schema.label: Profile the popup opens on
schema.description: The account the popup starts on. The bar icon always shows the worst state across every profile, whatever this says. Empty means the first profile gdrive-sync --list-profiles reports.

schema.label: Base allowance for a running sync (minutes)
schema.description: A base, not the whole limit: one more minute is allowed per folder in the run, and the total is capped at 2 hours, which is where systemd stops the sync anyway. A run past the limit reads as stuck rather than syncing.
